description:
About Us:

webAI is pioneering the future of artificial intelligence by establishing the first distributed AI infrastructure dedicated to personalized AI. We recognize the evolving demands of a data-driven society for scalability and flexibility, and we firmly believe that the future of AI lies in distributed processing at the edge, bringing computation closer to the source of data generation. Our mission is to build a future where a company's valuable data and intellectual property remain entirely private, enabling the deployment of large-scale AI models directly on standard consumer hardware without compromising the information embedded within those models. We are developing an end-to-end platform that is secure, scalable, and fully under the control of our users, empowering enterprises with AI that understands their unique business. We are a team driven by truth, ownership, tenacity, and humility, and we seek individuals who resonate with these core values and are passionate about shaping the next generation of AI.



About the Role:

We are seeking an Autonomy Integration Engineer to drive the integration of onboard autonomy, mission behaviors, and edge compute onto physical platforms for our Public Sector initiatives. You will own the boundary where software meets hardware—operating onboard compute, integrating sensors and vehicle interfaces, and getting real-time behaviors running reliably on resource-constrained platforms operating in DDIL environments.

This is a deeply hands-on systems role with high ownership. You will spend your time developing low-level integration and behavior code, deploying native and containerized workloads on small-form-factor edge hardware, debugging across hardware/OS/network boundaries, and proving systems from simulation to live field tests.

The ideal candidate will be based in Austin, Texas or in the Washington, D.C./Northern Virginia area. On a case-by-case basis, we will consider fully remote candidates. Qualified candidates who are not based in Austin, Texas may be asked to travel to our Austin, Texas headquarters. This role will require 25-50% travel, including occasional on-site work at customer locations to support deployment, troubleshooting, and integration of our platform within enterprise environments.



Responsibilities:

 - Architect, implement, and integrate on-platform autonomy behaviors, state management, and mission execution logic directly onto target vehicles and edge platforms.

 - Develop and maintain reliable vehicle, payload, and sensor interfaces—translating raw hardware protocols and telemetry streams into clean onboard data pipelines.

 - Design and tune low-latency interprocess communication (IPC) and message-passing architectures connecting sensor processing, planning, control, and external C2 systems.

 - Package, optimize, and deploy both native Linux and containerized (Docker) workloads onto SWaP-constrained edge compute hardware while managing CPU, memory, thermal, and bandwidth budgets.

 - Build and run hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), benchtop, and field integration tests; diagnose failures down to the thread, packet, driver, or sensor level.

 - Partner directly with autonomy, AI, and hardware/OEM teams to define platform interfaces, unblock integration issues, and harden prototype capabilities for real-world deployment.



Qualifications:

 - U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. Secret security clearance, or the ability to obtain one within six months of the start date.

 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in autonomy integration, robotics, embedded Linux, or defense edge systems.

 - Strong proficiency in C++ (or another unmanaged systems language such as Rust), with a solid grasp of manual memory management, pointer/smart pointer semantics, and deterministic resource control.

 - Integration experience with IPC mechanisms and message brokers (e.g., DDS, ZeroMQ, Zenoh, shared memory, or raw sockets).

 - Experience integrating hardware and sensor protocols (e.g., MAVLink, STANAG, CAN, serial/UART, SPI/I2C, UDP/TCP telemetry, or video/perception streams).

 - Proven track record deploying and optimizing production workloads—both natively on embedded Linux and in containers (Docker)—on small, resource-constrained ARM/edge hardware.

 - Strong low-level Linux debugging and systems troubleshooting skills across processes, networking, drivers, and physical hardware.

 - High bias for action and comfort working through ambiguity in fast-moving field and lab environments.

Preferred Skills:

 - Prior experience integrating autonomy stacks (e.g., ROS 2), flight/drive controllers, or onboard mission behaviors on uncrewed platforms (UxS), autonomous vehicles, or defense edge systems.

 - Experience optimizing workloads on embedded compute and microcontroller platforms.

 - Experience in low-level concurrent and parallel programming—multithreading, synchronization, contention debugging, and latency-sensitive execution pipelines.

 - Experience deploying real-time AI/ML inference pipelines on edge hardware alongside autonomy or sensor workloads.

 - Familiarity with simulation environments, HIL testbeds, and field test execution.

 - Experience operating or integrating systems in contested, degraded, or disconnected (DDIL) networking environments.

We hire for potential, not just a linear resume. If you’re passionate about what we’re building and excited by this work, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t check every box.



Why webAI?

At webAI we do our best to live out our core values we have put in place as the foundation on which we operate as a team. We are looking for people who are interested in personifying the same:

 - Truth - that which is true or in accordance with fact or reality; it’s not always easy, it’s not always pleasant, but we try to live by what reality is so we can accomplish something really cool

 - Ownership - the act, state or right of possessing something; we want you to fully own your responsibilities in this company, and continue to help define what fits in that purview and how we can help you be your best

 - Tenacity - persistent determination; we are really fired up about what we are trying to do here, and would love to have those who are fired up about what they do, to join us. If you really dig our mission, we certainly don’t mind that cherry on top

 - Humility - the quality of having a modest view of one’s value or importance; do we hope webAI can change the world? Certainly, but we know the only way to accomplish that is to not worry so much about the company’s accomplishments or status, but instead put all of that importance on building a world class team and treating them as such. We believe that’s the ultimate formula for success



Benefits:

We strive to provide competitive benefits to all employees. The benefits listed in this posting generally apply to U.S.-based employees. For employees hired outside the United States, benefits may vary based on local law, country-specific requirements, and the employment platform or entity through which the employee is hired.

 - Competitive salary and performance-based incentives

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits package
   
   - Including a high-deductible HSA option with $200/month company contribution

 - 401k match (US-based only)

 - Equity options

 - Flexible PTO Policy

 - Parental leave for eligible employees

 - Continuing education support

 - Basic, company-paid life insurance

 - Supplemental life insurance

 - Company-paid short and long term disability

 - Free parking for in-office employees



webAI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline. In addition, it is the policy of webAI to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances where a particular employee works.
